content: {"like":["Values high‑quality, unedited performance footage that captures the raw energy and historical significance of live shows; appreciates authentic, immersive presentations without added commentary or packaging; enjoys vivid, dynamic visuals and strong, charismatic performers; favors well‑crafted, intelligent filmmaking with wit and depth; seeks unique, memorable, and sometimes surreal artistic experiences."],"dislike":["Dislikes low‑resolution or poorly edited video that obscures key details; rejects excessive or distracting post‑production effects and intrusive commentary; avoids content with poor audio balance or distorted sound; dislikes pacing that is slow, erratic, or lacking narrative structure; shuns works that feel pretentious, inaccurate, or overly commercialized."]}
